anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world.
A female from the flock, a lamb or a kid, for sin.

pass_a_gloss: Those then who are perfect and already forcing themselves to be without sin will eat from the lambs, since Christ is the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world, but those still lying under sin will take from the kids, since the kid is said to be offered as a victim about sin according to the law.
pass_b_english: Those then who are perfect and already straining to be without sin will eat from the lambs, since Christ is the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. But those still [lying] under sin will [take] from the kids, since the kid is said according to the law to be offered [as a victim] for sin.
source_text: Οἱ <μὲν> οὖν τέλειοι καὶ ἤδη ἀναμάρτητοι βιαζόμενοι εἶναι ἀπὸ τῶν ἀμνῶν φάγονται, ἐπεὶ ὁ Χ(ριστό)ς ἐστιν ὁ ἀμνὸς τοῦ θ(εο)ῦ ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου, οἱ δὲ ὑπὸ ἁμαρτί]αν ἔτι [κε]ί[μενοι] ἀπ[ὸ τῶν ἐρ]ίφων [λήψοντ]αι, ἐπ[εὶ ὁ ἔρι]φος ἀναφέρεσθαι σ[φάγιον π]ερὶ ἁμαρ[τ]ίας εἴρητ[αι κα]τ[ὰ] τ[ὸ]ν νόμον.
